results.name: New mission starts with exactly five meals and finite stock
Threshold warning at 30 is emitted once, remains flagged, clears after eating
Hunger drains faster than old 0.035 and pauses on zero time
At low hunger work and sleep blocked while movement remains available
Zero carried food guides to stock and remote refill is impossible
Partial stock is handled atomically and stock never negative
Old save food, hp, reports, scanner and quizzes preserved on migration
Choices lock for the day and create different energy costs
Insufficient power rejects scan without removing cargo
Generator trades hunger for energy and cannot force hunger below threshold
Reserve charging is slower and charging consumes base power
Radiation emergency is separate from meteoroid weather and rooms remain safe
Resource exhaustion causes explicit failure without removing hp in safe room
Current save reload resumes scanner and preserves spent energy once
Assessment publishes bounded scores and does not call missing quizzes correct
Malformed new state and null quiz entries are rejected safely
